properties.name: `change_type` stops answering two questions at once: `ChangeSubject {system, record}` added as an optional axis, and `ChangeType::DefectFix` fills the system-axis gap. NOTE: this event carries NO `subject` of its own, because the server that wrote it is the pre-change binary — the field exists in the built code and is unreachable until a full client restart. Five sessions across three projects each picked a different least-wrong value before this existed.
